mapper.sql: select c.collection_id, c.name, c.description, c.source, c.source_ref, c.cover_url, c.owner_id, c.item_count, c.is_public, c.del_flag, u.user_name as owner_name, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from km_collection c left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.owner_id
mapper.insert: insert into km_collection (name, description, source, source_ref, cover_url, owner_id, item_count, is_public, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{name}, #{description}, #{source}, #{sourceRef}, #{coverUrl}, #{ownerId}, ifnull(#{itemCount},0), ifnull(#{isPublic},'0'), '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update km_collection set item_count = (select count(*) from km_collection_item i where i.collection_id = #{collectionId}) where collection_id = #{collectionId}
mapper.delete: update km_collection set del_flag = '2' where collection_id in #{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) from km_collection_follow where member_id = #{memberId} and collection_id = #{collectionId}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into km_collection_follow (member_id, collection_id, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{collectionId}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from km_collection_follow where member_id = #{memberId} and collection_id = #{collectionId}
